title: No-black cream/green visual system
decision: Override the source spec's dark control-room palette with cream canvas + deep green + gold/clay accents.
rationale: V12 adaptation makes no-black binding; must read as GolfHelm's premium cream/green world.

title: Local web command center first, not Tauri
decision: Ship a local Node HTTP server + static premium web UI before BaseballHelm product work.
rationale: Task 0 must be fast and verifiable in Chrome; Tauri/SQLite/PixiJS are post-build enhancements.

title: SSE over WebSockets
decision: Use Server-Sent Events for live updates with a polling fallback.
rationale: Simpler protocol, one-directional fits a telemetry dashboard; resilient if SSE drops.

title: Zero runtime dependencies
decision: Pure Node core (http, fs, child_process) — no npm install for the command center.
rationale: Avoid slowing Task 0 and avoid touching the repo lockfile; native git polling is sufficient.

title: Modular mode files against a shared ctx contract
decision: Each of the 15 modes is its own ES module rendering against shared h/ui/fmt helpers.
rationale: Enables parallel agent build with disjoint file ownership and guarantees visual consistency.
